messages.author: 7cefb99b9fdafa81
messages.subject: empty subsets
parts:
I am having a problem adding labels to specific subsets.
The code works fine if the subset is non-empty, but fails if the
subset is empty (all points are labeled).

Reproducible examples (ggplot 0.8.9, R 2.12.1 patched, Windows XP):

non-empty subset (works ok):
ggplot(mpg, aes(x=displ, y=cty, label=model)) + geom_point() +
geom_text(data=subset(mpg,cty>30/((displ/2)^0.7)),vjust=-1, size=2)

empty subset (does not work correctly, all points are labeled):
ggplot(mpg, aes(x=displ, y=cty, label=model)) + geom_point() +
geom_text(data=subset(mpg,cty>40/((displ/2)^0.7)),vjust=-1, size=2)

Right now I am going around the problem as follows, but I do not like
the solution much:
ggplot(mpg, aes(x=displ, y=cty, label=model)) + geom_point() +
(if(nrow(foo <- subset(mpg,cty>40/((displ/2)^0.7)))>0)
geom_text(data=foo, vjust=-1, size=2) else NULL)

Is there a better solution?
This problem is similar to the one mentioned in an old post present in
this forum ("Weird geom_point behavior with empty subset", Oct 19,
2009). I could not find this problem listed on github:
https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues.

Thanks,
Dario

messages.author: a5be32bcb3d808db
messages.subject: Re: empty subsets
parts:
Hi Dario,
Another work-around is

ggplot(mpg[NULL,], aes(x=displ, y=cty, label=model)) + geom_point(data=mpg) +
geom_text(data=subset(mpg,cty>40/((displ/2)^0.7)),vjust=-1, size=2)

It has the disadvantage of requiring a separate data= argument to each
geom, so I'm not convinced it's better, but it does give you another
option to consider.

Best,
Ista
